SWSE.TAH.Tooltips.AttackHint: Click: single attack  |  Shift+click: full attack
SWSE.TAH.Modes.ActiveTip: {mode} is ON — click to turn off
SWSE.TAH.Modes.InactiveTip: {mode} is OFF — click to turn on
SWSE.TAH.AttackMods.PrimedTip: PRIMED for next attack ({summary}) — click to remove
SWSE.TAH.AttackMods.UnprimedTip: Click to prime for next attack ({summary})
SWSE.TAH.Actions.SecondWindTooltip: Spend a swift action to heal 1/4 max HP + CON modifier. Once per encounter; resets after 8 hours of rest.
SWSE.TAH.Actions.EightHourRestTooltip: Rest for 8 hours: restore all hit points and reset Second Wind uses.
SWSE.TAH.Actions.RecoverTooltip: Standard Action: accumulate 3 Recover actions to improve condition by one step on the condition track.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.TotalDefenseTip: +5 Reflex Defense until next turn. Cannot attack or use skills.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.FightDefensivelyTip: −2 to attacks, +2 Reflex Defense until next turn.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.AidAnotherTip: DC 10 check to grant +2 attack or +2 defense to an ally.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.ChargeTip: Move up to 2× speed in a straight line; melee attack at −2. Flat-footed until next turn.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.WithdrawTip: Move up to 2× speed. First square vacated does not provoke. No attacks.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.DelayTip: Voluntarily act at a lower initiative count.
SWSE.TAH.Maneuvers.ReadyActionTip: Declare a trigger; interrupt it to take the readied action.
SWSE.TAH.Notifications.SecondWindUsed: {name} uses Second Wind and heals {heal} HP.
SWSE.TAH.Notifications.EightHourRest: {name} takes an 8-hour rest and recovers fully.
